basis: Listed by the firm itself as 'Sennder GmbH (ex Everoad S.A.S.)', on its lists from 2020. Earlybird's Everoad shares became Sennder shares in the June 2020 merger, which alone would be sale consideration; but it also put new money into Sennder's internal round at the merger (deutsche-startups 2020-06-09: it took part 'darueber hinaus mit weiterem Kapital an sennder'; Reuters the same day: Earlybird 'joined the latest internal funding round'). A firm that backs the acquirer on its own money holds a separate entry (COLLECTION.md s1; decisions.md R2). Everoad is its own row.

note: Sennder, digital road-freight forwarder, Berlin. Earlybird's entry is the unnamed internal round of June 2020 at the Everoad merger (existing investors, 'tens of millions of dollars'; Reuters 2020-06-09); the round has no name on record, so the stage is undetermined. Mark: the June 2021 Series D extension 'at a $1B valuation' (TechCrunch), more than 24 months old.

funding_rounds.round: internal round at the Everoad merger (unnamed)
